items.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
items.summary: The St Petersburg Oil Terminal was among targets hit in the city overnight At least one person has been killed in an overnight attack on St Petersburg that successfully targeted two of the city's oil facilities The region's Governor Alexander Beglov said fires were being extinguished at the St Petersburg Oil Terminal and the Ruchyi oil depot following the attack, which also injured at least five A logistics centre belonging to Ozon - known as Russia's Amazon - and a data centre belonging to Facebook equivalent VKontakte were also hit Kyiv has not yet commented on the strikes.

items.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
items.summary: Masked settlers are accused of attacking the convoy A delegation of European diplomats has been attacked by masked Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank Belgium condemned the assault on its consul general and the other envoys, while France decried the attack as "appalling". Both called for Israel to bring those responsible to justice The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) also condemned what they called "the severe act of violence" and said they were investigating But the office of the Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu cast doubt on what happened, suggesting it was part of a "co-ordinated campaign to smear Israel" The attack came only a day after a number of Palestinians and Heidi Levine, a Washington Post photographer, were injured in a separate assault by settlers in another village in the West Bank US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the attack on Levine was "disturbing" and "not a good look" It was also condemned by the US ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, who called it a "despicable act of terror carried out by masked cowards".

items.title: Vietnam signs free trade deal with four European countries
items.summary: Vietnam has signed a deal with four non-EU members that covers trade in goods and services, intellectual property rights, and sustainable development, among other areas Vietnam and four European countries signed a free trade agreement in Hanoi on Sunday The deal was announced by the governments of Vietnam and Norway Vietnam's Trade Ministry said it signed the deal with the European Free Trade Association (EFTA), which is made up Norway , Switzerland , Iceland and Liechtenstein The four European countries are not part of the European Union (EU) The official talks between Vietnam and the EFTA began in 2012.

items.title: Mozambique: ANE awards 20.6 billion meticais for Inhambane and Sofala road contracts
items.summary: According to the contract award notices published by ANE’s provincial delegations, the contracts concern new lots for road engineering and paving projects, five of which are located in Inhambane province, in southern Mozambique, and four in Sofala, in the centre of the country The awards fall under the 2026–2031 Accelerated National Road Rehabilitation and Construction Programme, known as “More Roads – 2031”, and cover national and regional road links In Inhambane province, the contracts total 285 kilometres and 10,104,807,009 meticais (€143.6 million) The contracts were awarded to a consortium comprising the companies Maripoma Entreprise Limitada, from Mozambique, Maripoma Entreprise Limitada, from Ghana, CC Building Limitada and GWIC Moçambique Limitada The largest lot in Inhambane covers the 70-kilometre Sitila–Funhalouro section of road R444, awarded for 2,469,027,132 meticais (€35 million) On the same road corridor, the 40-kilometre Massinga–Sitila section was awarded for 1,612,980,998 meticais (€22.9 million) On national road N222, the 58-kilometre Mapinhane–Macumene section…
